_source: Blueprint H2 (page overview), H3 (panel script) and B4 (twist narration). Text only; layout lives in content/pages/*.json (Garv). Fragment text is in evidence.json, referenced by id. 'drawn' is art direction, not on-screen text. Speech tone is the H3 bubble note.

mira.title: The Bell at 2:17
mira.setting: Schoolhouse and clock tower, incident night
mira.layout: 2x3 grid; P3/P4 centre emphasis; P6 wide bottom
mira.openingNarration: The bell stopped the same way every clock did.
mira.closingNarration: The evidence was clearer than the memory.
mira.twistNarration: I remembered the bell, but not the hand that made it ring.

panels.drawn: Mira in classroom; register and clock visible.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.line: The lesson ended before the bell.

panels.narration: The village still looked ordinary before the minute that broke it.

panels.drawn: School clock, stopwatch and register with conflicting marks.
Clock tower rope untouched; lantern symbol glowing in stone.
panels.narration: No hand had pulled the rope. Something else had.

panels.drawn: Mira sees a later timestamp written on a wall ledger.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.line: This was written after the bell.

panels.narration: The minute was fixed. The night was not.

panels.drawn: Black residue and silhouette holding lantern staff.
panels.narration: I knew the tools before I knew the face.

panels.drawn: Register shows erased apprentice entry beside Nia clinic note.
panels.narration: Someone had tried to remove a name from the story.

arun.title: The Dry River
arun.setting: River road and sluice path, incident night
arun.silhouette: P4 on the dry river path
arun.openingNarration: The river should have carried me away from the tower.
arun.closingNarration: The time on my watch was the time they erased.
arun.twistNarration: The road should have taken me away from the tower.

panels.drawn: Arun on riverbank; boat tied at normal water level in first memory layer.
panels.narration: I remember the water because it was the last ordinary thing.

panels.drawn: Arun checks pocket watch at 2:31 while village clock shows 2:17.
panels.narration: The watch remembered a different night.

panels.drawn: Emergency sluice and dry river channel; muddy footprints disappear underground.
panels.narration: The river did not vanish. It was diverted.

panels.drawn: Dry path; silhouette carrying a child toward lantern-house.
Close figure with lantern case marked with partial E.V.
panels.narration: I had seen that case before.

panels.drawn: River floods the underground channel; ghost echoes appear in the water.
panels.narration: The same water carried the same memory twice.

leela.title: The Lantern Below
leela.setting: Lantern workshop and underground archive, minutes before and after the overload
leela.openingNarration: The lantern had rules. I remembered teaching them to him.
leela.closingNarration: The machine did not malfunction. Someone told it to do this.
leela.twistNarration: Leela warned him once. I did not remember why.

panels.drawn: Leela at the Echo Lantern workbench with diagrams.

dialogue.speaker: leela
dialogue.line: It records. It extracts. It can transfer.

panels.narration: The lantern was never a simple lamp.

panels.drawn: Blueprint showing village nodes connected to one chamber.

dialogue.speaker: leela
dialogue.line: Never connect all nodes at once.

panels.narration: The warning was written in her own hand.

panels.drawn: Nia's clinic card beside a child-sized chair and hairclip.
panels.narration: Someone had already asked the lantern a question it could not answer.

panels.drawn: Young Elias attaching network cables, Leela reaching for him.
panels.narration: I had forgotten the exact shape of the moment.

panels.drawn: Console overload; village map lights across every node; black residue spreads.
panels.narration: The lantern did what it had been told to do.

panels.drawn: Archive collapses; master log, purge note and silhouette at console.
panels.narration: After the experiment, someone removed his own name from the evidence.

twistNarrationExtra.intro: I had never been inside Veyra before.
twistNarrationExtra.casebook: I could not place the figure, but I could place his tools.
